result_summary.title: Compliance report in Staging Analytics Dashboard is incomplete
result_summary.description: We are seeing an issue with the compliance reporting feature in our staging environment for the Analytics Dashboard. When generating the monthly compliance report, the output is missing several sections that should be populated based on the data in the system. This is affecting our ability to validate regulatory compliance before pushing changes to production. Approximately 700 internal users rely on these reports for their workflows. Can you investigate why the report generation is truncating or omitting these fields?
